screen_rule: Equal sample weighting, full4pair coverage in all8 and no fallback; 6/8 joint velocity/postwarp improvements and both mean ratios below1 => MECHANISM_ONLY. Both mean velocity ratios at least1 => NO_GAIN_IN_SCOPE. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE; partial never decides.
decoder_policy: Scoped cuDNN benchmark false/deterministic true on both OFF/ON; TF32 unchanged, restore on exit
point_selection: OFF trace both-CFG skip with 2 past full anchors each, up to4 evenly spaced eligible ranks; save before ON scoring
groups: Four nonempty latent-time bins,2x2 spatial tiles,four channel bins; source-verified residualBTHWD/velocityBCTHW
stop: Any OFF/ON model/cache/rawdecode/safety/accepted-video mismatch or nonfinite/unknown error aborts. Rejections are outcomes and remain denominator.
limitation: CAL development/diagnostic only; no new method deployed, clean latency, quality, or independent confirmation.
